cohort: The cohort consisted of 385 parturients aged over 18 years who underwent cesarean section at a referral hospital in Kigali, Rwanda.
finding: The quality of post-cesarean section pain management within 24 hours was generally good, leading to satisfaction in most patients, although pain control was lower immediately after recovery admission, and morphine was associated with higher patient satisfaction.
mod_finding: The quality of post-cesarean section pain management was found to be good, leading to satisfaction among most patients.
cross-section timing: Within the first 24 hours post-cesarean section
